objs.name: document
objs.description: Information object representing a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other controlled document in the DHC VISION system.

objs.name: documenttype
objs.description: Type of a Document (e.g., Policies, Guidelines, Procedural Instructions, Work Instructions).

objs.name: documenttemplate
objs.description: Template defined for a DocumentType, used when creating new Document objects.

objs.name: masterdata
objs.description: Master data linked with a Document (e.g., IT applications).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment to a Document representing an information object.

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: Additional information attached to a Document.

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: Group of users assigned to roles and authorizations for documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user who participates in document workflows.
